description: This Java source file defines an Akka actor class 'RetrieveConnectionStatusAggregatorActor' used to aggregate connection status messages from multiple resources in a distributed system. It processes `ResourceStatus` messages, tracks responses, manages timeouts, and compiles a comprehensive status response to a requester.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionStatusAggregatorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class that aggregates `ResourceStatus` messages from multiple resources, manages responses and timeouts, and produces a consolidated connection status response.
